sys_script_include.description: Scheduled data-retention utility for the AI audit table (x_ctans_incentnow_incentiq_ai_audit). Purges audit records older than the admin-configured retention period (x_ctans_incentnow.audit_retention_days; 0 disables) in safe batches. Invoked daily by the "IncentIQ Audit Retention Cleanup" scheduled job.
sys_script_include.name: IncentIQAuditMaintenance
